additional_projects.name: MirageMesh
additional_projects.title: A local security workflow, from sensor to incident.
additional_projects.summary: A local-first security application with a supervised Go engine, isolated decoys, durable offline event spooling and a browser interface for incident replay and triage.
additional_projects.scope: The reference workflow is verified on Ubuntu 24.04 Linux amd64. Other hosts require their own workflow evidence; the complete OSS v1 gate is pending.
